en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate historic building with richly decorated façades and large arched windows. In front of the building is a terrace café with tables, chairs, umbrellas, and people walking along the promenade. The sign on the awning reads "CAFÉ PUPP," and printed text at the bottom left identifies the scene as 'Weltbad Karlsbad. Café Pupp'. The backdrop consists of wooded hills.
